result.title: Alignment under Hard Negative Re-Pairing: Cross-Modal Similarity, Scale and Retrieval
result.comment: 52 pages, including references and supplementary material
result.summary: Do vision and language models represent the world alike? That question hides three: what structure each modality has, whether the two modalities organize images and their captions alike, and whether a model ranks an image's own caption highly. Centered kernel alignment (CKA) and neighborhood agreement answer the second, yet matching and model selection use them as if they identified individual pairs and answered the third. To test this reading, we introduce hard negative re-pairing: every image receives the caption of a similar image, and nothing else changes. Although no image keeps its own caption and annotators judge a majority of the substituted captions wrong, CKA stays higher than under a random re-pairing that keeps 80% of the original pairs. In all 22 image-text models we test, neighborhood agreement loses far less than top-one retrieval, which collapses. The reason is scale: these diagnostics pool over many neighbors, matching and retrieval are decided among the nearest ones, and an exact decomposition shows that near-neighbor pairs contribute almost nothing to CKA. In the matching problems we test, an exact maximizer of CKA would not return the original pairing. On COCO and Flickr30k, the model with the highest diagnostic value retrieves worse on held-out data than the model chosen by validation recall, even where the two correlate positively. What re-pairing removes is the informative part: that share tracks retrieval on both datasets and ranks encoder pairs before alignment training. A diagnostic should be reported with its question and its scale, and tested against hard negative re-pairing.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 hard negative re-pairing（把每张图的 caption 换成相似图的 caption），检验 CKA 与 neighborhood agreement 是否真能识别单个图文配对：22 个图文模型中 CKA 仍高于保留八成原配对的随机重配，近邻一致性损失远小于完全崩溃的 top-1 检索，并给出尺度分解说明近邻对几乎不贡献 CKA。
AI.relevance_reason: 对 latent 相似度诊断有直接方法线索：CKA 类指标由池化尺度与多邻居主导，而非个体配对内容，可供核查用这类指标判断 latent 是否保留具体视觉细节时是否失真，以及聚合相似度与检索式证据之间的取舍。
